messages:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing 'micro-lease windows' — ephemeral GPU residency (tenstohundreds ms) tied to a microbatch to avoid fetch storms when serving mixed streaming + batch traffic. sketch below, want concerns + blockers.

nina: Short q: how do we pick window size per endpoint? per-model static default or adaptive? and eviction semantics (sync vs async)?

rick: Impl sketch: allocator returns lease token with deadline + affinity label. runtime pins pages and attaches token to request context. on pressure allocator issues async revoke. runtime checks token at next safe point (next token-gen) and either demotes or falls back to a tiny inline fetch. We should expose token metadata in traces.

jesse: Major risk: fragmentation & allocator slowpaths if lots of short leases scatter addresses. Mitigations: align leases to 4KiB slab units, try immediate buddy-coalesce on free, and reuse free-lease cache for hot prefixes. Also add per-tenant soft-quotas for lease_pages.

alex: config proposal (endpoint-level):

{
  "micro_lease_pages": "64",
  "micro_lease_ms": "150",
  "preempt_mode": "async_notify",
  "priority_hint": "interactive",
  "numa_preference": "local_first"
}

defaults are conservative; experiments can tune.

nina: Telemetry we should capture: lease_grants, lease_revokes, avg_lease_hold_ms, lease_revoke_latency_ms, pinned_pages_per_tenant, cross_numa_copy_pct, p99_gen_latency_with_lease. Add a tag for model-id + endpoint.

rick: bench-bot: run summary for branch bench/micro-lease: interactive trace p99 down ~2.8%, mean unchanged. Stress-8 test failed with pin-free race under heavy revoke. logs: https://ci.fake/bench/micro-lease/stress-8 (short)

alex: ack. plan: feature-flag behind 'micro_lease' experiment. POC phase = grant-only + simple revoke notify. Later add coalesce + admission controller. volunteers?

nina: I'll own telemetry + perf dashboards.

rick: I can do allocator changes + revoke RPC path.

jesse: I'll add runtime checks + safe-point demote logic and a small inline fetch fallback. Will also add unit tests for forced revoke.

alex: one more operational idea: escalation policy. if tenant sees >X revokes in Y minutes, runtime suggests a fallback: smaller k-v cache variant or temporary throttle. record suggestion in endpoint events.

bench-bot: ci: reproduced stress leak locally; root cause = missing free on revoke when pinned_count races with async unpin. added unit test and patch queued.

alex: nice. timeline: POC branch -> perf replay -> RFC PR w/ diagrams and sample traces -> canary on dedicated pool. I'll open the RFC draft tonight.

nina: also add an A/B in replay harness that mixes heavy batch with taily streaming to validate fairness heuristics.

rick: will add TODO in allocator PR for coalesce pass + tenant accounting.

jesse: adding stress harness to simulate random revoke + cross-node copies.

alex: thanks all. closing loop: expect PR and bench links in thread.
